articles.headline: AFL Grand Final: Ins and outs, fixtures, games, tips, odds -- everything you need to know
articles.description: It's finally here, the 2026 AFL Grand Final is set to take place at the MCG this Saturday at 2:30pm, with the Fremantle Dockers facing the Brisbane Lions. Here's everything you need to know.

images.name: Dockers [1296x729]
images.caption: The Dockers have now won 11 games in a row.
images.credit: Photo by Russell Freeman/AFL Photos via Getty Images

images.name: Hird: Patrick Voss has a role to play on Harris Andrews
images.caption: On ESPN Footy Central, James Hird says Fremantle's Patrick Voss needs to act as a disruptive defensive forward on Harris Andrews if the Dockers are to beat the Lions.

articles.headline: Lachie Neale ban overturned, free to play AFL Grand Final
articles.description: Star Brisbane midfielder Lachie Neale has been cleared to play in the AFL grand final after overturning his one-game suspension at the appeals board.

articles.headline: Jaspa Fletcher outlines Lachie Neale legacy ahead of crucial call
articles.description: Jaspa Fletcher will line up for his fourth AFL grand final in as many seasons aware he may never run out alongside Lachie Neale again.

images.name: JASPA FLETCHER [1296x729]

images.caption: On the ESPN Footy Podcast, Jake Michaels says Lachie Neale has to miss a week for his "moronic" gut punch, and urges the AFL to close loopholes for special considerations.

articles.headline: All-time greats and Hall of Fame locks: Those with the most to gain with a premiership win
articles.description: Are all premiership medallions equal? Wrong. A flag would mean far more for some than others. Jake Michaels ranks the top 10 people with the most to gain on Grand Final day.
